title: Calculation Sheet: Opening Credit of a Manufacturer Copay Card Benefit Period (Savings & Copay Assistance Programs)
content:
The opening credit of a Manufacturer Copay Card benefit period under the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs is the program's annual benefit maximum, stated to the cent and rounded half up.

The annual benefit maximum is the program's figure for program dollars per benefit period on the benefit dollars schedule.

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

| Program | Program dollars per benefit period | Opening credit |
|---|---|---|
| Manufacturer Copay Card | $9600.00 | $9600.00 |
